with_licence.overall_line: A Conditional Use Authorization is needed (use control of a special use district). A Conditional Use Authorization is needed if the business occupies no story other than the first story or the basement (use control of the zoning district). Zoning does not permit the concept if the business occupies the second story or the third story or above (use control of the zoning district). A Conditional Use Authorization is needed if the business is part of a chain with eleven or more other locations (formula retail). A Conditional Use Authorization is needed if the floor area is 3,001 square feet or more and either the floor area grows or storefronts are merged (use size). Of the 5 approvals this concept needs: 2 further review (entertainment permit, building permit and change of use), 2 insufficient information (zoning and use, alcohol licence), 1 allowed (health permit).

no_licence.overall_line: A Conditional Use Authorization is needed (use control of a special use district). A Conditional Use Authorization is needed if the business occupies no story other than the first story or the basement (use control of the zoning district). Zoning does not permit the concept if the business occupies the second story or the third story or above (use control of the zoning district). A Conditional Use Authorization is needed if the business is part of a chain with eleven or more other locations (formula retail). A Conditional Use Authorization is needed if the floor area is 3,001 square feet or more and either the space was last used as another use (not a Bar, a Restaurant, a Limited Restaurant, Nighttime Entertainment, a retail use or a laundromat), or the floor area grows, or storefronts are merged (use size). Of the 5 approvals this concept needs: 1 further review (entertainment permit), 3 insufficient information (zoning and use, alcohol licence, building permit and change of use), 1 allowed (health permit).
